<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves all available asset audit policy types. Policy types define the category or classification of audit policies (e.g., scheduled physical verification, compliance audit, inventory check).

**Response Details:**
- Returns the complete set of policy type definitions available in the system
- Can be used when creating or configuring audit policies
- Returned types include metadata such as display names, descriptions, and configuration options specific to each policy type
